title: Desk hand-off protocol for desk-opened positions, then lift the claude_desk max_hold_min <= 60 cap on bybit_1 demo (operator-approved, conditional)
note:
OPERATOR, popup ~22:30Z 2026-10-30, verbatim (relayed by Manager Session 2026-10-30c): "We can lift it completely if we have a protocol for trade desk hand-offs". The 60-min max_hold_min cap on claude_desk entries goes ENTIRELY (bybit_1 demo; the other paper books' scope is unchanged; no real money or prop), CONDITIONAL on this protocol because each desk wake is a fresh session.

The protocol must hold:
(a) Every desk-opened position carries its thesis, falsifiable forecast (direction, target, horizon, p), invalidation level and exit plan in the decision record. Reuse the live-review `forecast` object from DESK-AM-REFOCUS (#21731) inside desk_write.py's proposal.
(b) Every later wake that touches the position receives that record in its packet, and must explicitly CONFIRM, REVISE (with reason) or EXIT. Its decision row links to the prior one, a chain per position (prior_decision_id).
(c) The 4h judgement_cadence wake (#21732) covers desk-opened positions too, so no desk position goes longer than one cadence without an owner. Check that claude_desk packages are on the daily_floor account list and not excluded as short_hold 5m/15m.
(d) An invariant check (an attention_watch-style flag, not a gate) catches an orphaned desk position: open with no desk decision inside cadence + slack.
(e) If a hand-off read fails (could_not_look), the position keeps its existing SL/TP. Never a silent orphan, never a halt.

The cap lift lands in the SAME PR as the protocol or after it, never before. The cap is Tier 3, operator-approved under this condition; the runtime pieces are Tier 2. Hold the PR and wake the manager with the PR number and the green head sha.

Where the cap lives: DESK-BRIEF.md section 3 and desk_write.py (max_hold_min 1-60 on a live market entry); the leg closes at max_hold_min (claude_desk in config/strategies.yaml + the short-hold lane). Filed by lane DESK-AM-REFOCUS (session_01AFoLuLYH6B5e8LJSBB8q9x) at its ceiling. 2026-10-31 lane session_01AFoLuJghnUym97LJh6wmxa: step 0 = PR #21750 (Tier 1, self-land). Steps 1-2 = held Tier-3 PR on branch desk-handoff-protocol (stacked on #21750): desk_handoff packet block + validator chain check + short_hold_write handoff_verdict + desk_orphan flag + cap removed. Live-data check: handoff_block over the 3 real claude_desk packages in the journal (diag pull) found every opening row and the 8-row chain on pkg-3cdb3c39. Open: deployed + observed (a cadence review judging every package incl. could_not_look; a multi-hour desk proposal getting a chained follow-up).
